_note: Maps the deploy.sh user choice (standard|relaxed|strict) to the preset key in alarm-thresholds.json. Kept as a separate file so future presets (e.g. enterprise) can be added without touching CDK code.

descriptions.standard: Sensible defaults for personal / small-team deployments (5x5xx-3min, 5% error rate, 1 throttled user)
descriptions.relaxed: Tolerant of bursty workloads — fewer pages, may miss short incidents
descriptions.strict: Page on every anomaly — for production-critical deployments only
